d2_answers.question: Separate organic growth from acquisition/consolidation effects.
d2_answers.fact: The Sep-2025 acquisition of the Hulunbuir extreme-testing center was under common control, so historical comparatives were restated. 2026 Q1 adjusted profit growth of 75.5% explicitly includes the acquired entity, and the company also states that the Salt City proving ground began generating revenue from 2024 H2.
d2_answers.interpretation: Reported YoY growth mixes organic ramp, same-control consolidation and prior-period restatement. The current disclosures do not provide a clean standalone pro-forma bridge by entity.
d2_answers.judgment: PARTIAL. Organic direction is positive, but exact organic growth remains unproven.

d2_answers.question: Model utilization, pricing, incremental margins and ROIC for new testing capacity.
d2_answers.fact: The Salt City smart-connected proving ground has about RMB1.281bn investment and was still described as capacity-ramping; 2025 realized project benefits were far below mature expected benefits. H1 2025 disclosures show depreciation from new facilities raising costs.
d2_answers.interpretation: Incremental margins can improve sharply with utilization because the cost base is fixed-asset heavy, but no sufficiently granular utilization, price/mix or project-level incremental EBITDA/ROIC series is disclosed.
d2_answers.judgment: BLOCKED. This is the decisive unresolved D2 question; do not mark D2 complete until project-level utilization and return proxies can be reconstructed from subsequent H1/H2 disclosures.

d2_answers.question: Assess convertible-bond dilution and balance-sheet implications.
d2_answers.fact: The 2026 convertible bond raised RMB1.039bn gross / RMB1.030bn net at a RMB5.99 conversion price. Full conversion would imply roughly 173.5m new shares, about 13.1% of the current weighted share base before conversion (about 11.6% of post-conversion shares). Proceeds fund another large ice/snow testing base.
d2_answers.interpretation: The bond initially adds funding capacity and execution runway but introduces meaningful future dilution and doubles down on capital-intensive proving-ground expansion before the prior major project has demonstrated mature returns.

d2_answers.question: Map competitive moat and customer concentration.
d2_answers.fact: 2025 top-five customers were 57.25% of revenue; controlling shareholder 中汽中心 alone represented 20.17%. The company operates complementary proving grounds across Salt City, Hulunbuir, Hainan and Changchun and has specialized smart-connected/extreme-climate test infrastructure.
d2_answers.interpretation: The moat is physical/scenario infrastructure plus the CATARC ecosystem and nationwide climate coverage, but customer concentration and related-party demand reduce the independence of the demand signal.

d2_answers.question: Define valuation ceiling and utilization/ROIC kill conditions.
d2_answers.assumption: Until mature project ROIC is demonstrated, use a maximum research multiple of about 30x normalized RMB220-250m earnings (EPS roughly RMB0.17-0.19), implying an analytical ceiling around RMB5.0-5.7/share before considering full-conversion dilution.
d2_answers.judgment: Kill conditions: (1) Salt City utilization/benefits remain well below mature plan after another full operating year; (2) combined new-project after-tax return fails to clear an 8-10% research hurdle after ramp; (3) customer/related-party concentration rises while third-party growth slows; (4) conversion dilution occurs without proportionate earnings accretion. Because condition (1) cannot yet be evidenced, status remains HOLD/EVIDENCE_GAP.

evidence_gap.missing: Project-level utilization, realized pricing/mix and incremental return series sufficient to calculate mature ROIC for Salt City and to underwrite the new ice/snow base.
evidence_gap.recovery: Revisit at next formal H1/H2/annual disclosure or a primary-source IR disclosure with utilization/benefit metrics.
